# DRIFT004: reattest-required

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| Field | Value |

| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A lock entry was recorded under another file version or digest scheme and must be re-attested.

Fires once per entry (symbol or flow) when `frob.lock` predates this build's format
version or digest scheme. The digests are not comparable across schemes, so no drift
rule judges such an entry and nothing is silently accepted; `frob ack --all --reason ...`
re-records every entry under the current scheme.

## Examples

### DRIFT004 re-attestation required / A version 1 lock fires #1 (line 8) (fire)

```text
=== frob.lock
version = 1

[entries."a.rs::a"]
sig = "11"
body = "22"
doc = "33"
acked_by = "Me"
acked_at = "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"
reason = "old"
=== a.rs
pub fn a() {}
```

### DRIFT004 re-attestation required / A repository without a lock is clean #2 (line 25) (clean)
